reason: The cited evidence (E1) only generally supports the formation of a γ+γ′ structure in a similar Ni-Co-Fe-Cr-Al-Ti HEA, but provides no specific data on Al/Ti partitioning to precipitates, interfacial diffusion kinetics, oxide phase formation, or failure mechanisms. The key mechanistic premises about degradation are entirely unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: Fine γ/γ′ microstructure exists in the AM Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3 HEA
Reactive elements Al and Ti reside in or near γ′-like precipitates
Oxygen (or reducing species) diffuses rapidly along interphase boundaries at high temperature
Preferential oxidation of Al and Ti at interfaces forms brittle Al2O3 and TiO2 phases
Buildup of interfacial oxides creates stress concentrations and microcracks leading to catastrophic failure
